stories.title: Kremlin: no date set for next Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: Dmitry Peskov said there is an understanding that three-way talks with Ukraine and the US will resume in Abu Dhabi, but no date has been fixed. He added Moscow does not yet see what Europe would add if the format expands to four parties, which European capitals are pressing for.

stories.title: UK sanctions Houthis as attacks hit Red Sea shipping
stories.summary: Britain designated the Houthis as an entity under its Yemen sanctions regime and targeted four senior figures over torture and sexual violence against detainees. London said the move follows renewed Houthi attacks on commercial shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb and on Saudi civilian infrastructure.

stories.title: Israeli strike kills head of Hamas internal security in Gaza City
stories.summary: An Israeli airstrike killed Naeem Abu Nahel, director of Hamas' internal security apparatus, in western Gaza City on Tuesday, according to Hamas sources. The Israeli military and Shin Bet confirmed striking a senior Hamas figure; at least seven Palestinians were reported killed across Gaza in the day's strikes.

stories.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price in AI-sector warning
stories.summary: Anthropic traded as low as $76 a share on Tuesday, below its $83 IPO price and nearly 12% under Monday's close, less than a week after debuting at $111.50. The slide is being read as a barometer for how public investors value AI companies and could pressure private valuations.

stories.title: Meta puts its Muse AI assistant inside Instagram DMs
stories.summary: Instagram users in the US, Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore can now chat with Meta's Muse agent in a DM thread to get context on posts, places and products, or catch up on missed conversations. Muse can also organize saved posts and reels into collections, tying the assistant to where users already shop and discover content.

stories.title: Tidal to delete 29 million fully AI-generated tracks
stories.summary: Tidal said more than 43% of tracks uploaded in the past 90 days were fully AI-generated, prompting it to start removing such songs on December 9 and reject roughly 80,000-85,000 uploads a day. Material made with AI assistance, rather than generated outright, will still be accepted.

stories.title: Amazon buys Decart tech for a reported $7.5B to boost Trainium
stories.summary: Amazon acquired Decart's model-optimization technology and team, reportedly for $7.5 billion, to squeeze more performance from its in-house Trainium AI chips. The Decart Optimization Stack is aimed at running models well on non-Nvidia silicon as AWS chases Nvidia's near-monopoly.

stories.title: Browns back at work focused on Sunday night, not playoff math
stories.summary: Coming off a bye in which all three AFC North rivals lost, Cleveland (6-4) returned to practice as the AFC's No. 6 seed with a Sunday night home game against Las Vegas (4-7) ahead. Players and coaches said the message is one game at a time, with the team still the only one in the league yet to score on an opening possession.

stories.title: Rookie WR Denzel Boston sits out first post-bye practice
stories.summary: Cleveland's leading receiver missed Tuesday's session along with four others as the Browns began preparing for the Raiders, after playing through a toe injury in the Week 10 win over Houston. The staff has two more practices before Sunday night's flexed kickoff.

stories.title: Denzel Ward's Pro Bowl form anchors Browns' playoff push
stories.summary: Ward has matched his career high with three interceptions and has 12 passes defensed, allowing only 22 completions on 45 targets for 145 yards. Houston tested him a season-high nine times in Week 10 and got 16 yards out of it.

stories.title: Browns designate RB Raheim Sanders for return from IR
stories.summary: Cleveland designated Raheim Sanders to return to practice after he missed seven games with a hip injury suffered in Week 5 against the Jets. The team has a 21-day window to activate him, and he could be available for Sunday night's game against the Raiders.

stories.title: Urban Meyer 'a little concerned' about Buckeyes before The Game
stories.summary: Meyer said the noise around Columbus and Michigan's defense, the best unit in Saturday's matchup, have him worried, though he backed Ryan Day and expects a low-scoring rock fight. Ohio State is a 10.5-point favorite against a 6-5 Michigan team that just beat UCLA.

stories.title: Day: defense 'not been very good,' and only Michigan matters now
stories.summary: In his final Tuesday press conference of the regular season, Ryan Day conceded Ohio State's second-half defensive performance has not been good enough and said the 7-4 record must be ignored with Michigan coming to Columbus. Matt Patricia took responsibility for the scheme and said he needs to simplify the playbook in a short, emotional week.

stories.title: Stella says Piastri has found his 'superpower' again
stories.summary: McLaren's Andrea Stella credited Piastri's Las Vegas podium to better energy deployment and low-grip confidence, letting him match Lando Norris' pace after a difficult middle of the season. Stella called it promising for the final two rounds and for carrying form into 2027.

stories.title: Verstappen uneasy about Qatar and Abu Dhabi races
stories.summary: Max Verstappen said he would rather stay home than travel to the Middle East for the final two rounds, even after F1 gave drivers private security assurances. F1 has dropped Imola as a fallback and committed to holding both races as scheduled.

stories.title: Audi junior Freddie Slater gets F2 seat for final two rounds
stories.summary: Slater, 18, will replace Rafael Camara at Invicta Racing in Qatar and Abu Dhabi ahead of his full-time 2027 promotion, after finishing runner-up in F3. Camara leads the F2 standings but has moved to Haas in F1 to cover for the sidelined Esteban Ocon.

stories.title: Sainz questions how McLaren and Red Bull keep upgrading
stories.summary: Sainz said Williams has no budget-cap room left while rivals keep bringing seven or eight upgrades a year, and noted Williams must spend part of its allowance catching up on facilities. His P8 in Las Vegas was only Williams' second points finish since Monaco.

stories.title: Unity 6 update is Tarkov's biggest technical change in years
stories.summary: The 1.3.5.0 patch groups graphics work under a new RenderStack platform, improving optics, shadows, decals and DLSS/FSR stability, while Battlestate credits months of profiling for the frame-rate gains. DirectX 12, DLSS Frame Generation and the vegetation rework are pushed to later updates, with FSR 4 due before year's end.

stories.title: Tarkov patch 1.3.5.0 brings Unity 6 and fast raid reconnects
stories.summary: Battlestate shipped the long-delayed technical update, reworking raid loading so server connection runs in parallel with the map, adding a reconnect that skips reloading world state after a dropped connection, and fixing memory leaks. The Halloween event has ended and Scav karma behavior reverted to standard.

stories.title: Black smoke over west Columbus traced to trash fire
stories.summary: Columbus firefighters responded to a trash fire in the 3600 block of Windward Way near I-70 and I-270, sending a plume visible from downtown. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: Murder charge filed after woman killed near east side gas station
stories.summary: Derek Pearson, 26, was arrested by a SWAT team and charged with murder in the shooting death of Larisa Whitfield, 51, on East Hudson Street. A second victim is expected to survive; Pearson is set for arraignment Wednesday.

stories.title: Leaked Ohio 'quick take' bill draws farmland backlash
stories.summary: A draft bill would extend Ohio's deposit-and-build authority to utilities building pipelines, power lines and water lines, letting construction start before compensation disputes are settled. The Ohio Farm Bureau and a Union County farmer who fought a Columbia Gas pipeline say it would strip landowners' leverage; no formal introduction yet.
